info.name: Urumi Gateway
info.description: Run the folders in order. See services/gateway/POSTMAN.md. Tokens and ids are captured into collection variables automatically.

request.description: 200 when PostgreSQL is reachable and migrated.
Then run in a terminal: poetry run gateway-admin grant-platform-admin <adminEmail> (needed to register connectors).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', d.access_token); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminUserId', d.user.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('connectorId', d.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('teamId', d.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('inviteToken', d.token); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('memberToken', d.access_token); }

item.name: Member sees no connectors before grant

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('memberKey', d.key); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('memberKeyId', d.id); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminKey', d.key); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminKeyId', d.id); }

request.description: An unknown id returns 200 with isError: true (the tool's own error).
Send twice: the second call returns the same product (idempotency in the MCP server).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('memberKey', d.key); }
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('memberKeyId', d.id); }
